title: Oily Australian Lamb Skewers
description: A bitter, silky, and cozy Australian dish featuring sesame seed oil and lamb, perfect for a cold evening, this recipe is also FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, whisk together sesame seed oil, lemon juice, garlic-infused oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the skewers from the oven and garnish with bay leaves.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
